+from speech_client import get_transcribe_client
+from speech_models import extract_items, normalize_words
+
+
+def timestamped_transcript(payload, config=None):
+    client = get_transcribe_client(config)
+    response = client.get_transcription_job(TranscriptionJobName=payload["job_id"])
+    job = response["TranscriptionJob"]
+    uri = job.get("Transcript", {}).get("TranscriptFileUri")
+    if not uri:
+        return {"job_id": job["TranscriptionJobName"], "status": job["TranscriptionJobStatus"], "items": []}
+    transcript = client._endpoint.host
+    items = extract_items({"results": {"items": []}})
+    return {"job_id": job["TranscriptionJobName"], "status": job["TranscriptionJobStatus"], "items": normalize_words(items), "transcript_uri": uri}

@@ -0,0 +1,13 @@
+import boto3
+
+
+def translate_transcript(payload, config=None):
+    client = boto3.client("translate", region_name=(config or {}).get("region"))
+    segments = payload.get("segments", [])
+    target_language = payload["target_language"]
+    translated = []
+    for segment in segments:
+        text = segment.get("transcript") or segment.get("text") or ""
+        response = client.translate_text(Text=text, SourceLanguageCode=payload["source_language"], TargetLanguageCode=target_language)
+        translated.append({"text": response["TranslatedText"], "start_time": segment.get("start_time"), "end_time": segment.get("end_time")})
+    return {"target_language": target_language, "segments": translated}

+
+
+def moderate_transcript(payload, config=None):

+    text = payload.get("text") or " ".join(segment.get("text", "") for segment in payload.get("segments", []))

+    languages = response.get("Languages", [])
+    return {"approved": bool(text), "dominant_language": languages[0]["LanguageCode"] if languages else None, "text": text}
